title: Transfer Days to Auction for Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Repossessed Vehicles
content:
A vehicle repossessed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract that has to be moved to the auction adds transfer days before its sale. Where the vehicle is follows from the contract's records: the recovery type and the most recent condition report (the first one listed where two share a date).

| Where the vehicle is | Transfer days added |
|---|---|
| Held on the storage lot: an involuntary recovery whose most recent condition report is dated on or after the repossession date | 2 (the lot transfer days) |
| A voluntary surrender, left at a designated Kestrel dealer | 4 (the dealer transfer days) |
| Still at the agency's yard: an involuntary recovery with no condition report dated on or after the repossession date | none — the agency delivers it to the auction |

### Hypothetical records

| Records | Transfer days |
|---|---|
| Involuntary, repossessed on the 3rd, condition report on the 6th | 2 |
| Involuntary, repossessed on the 3rd, condition report on the 3rd | 2 |
| Involuntary, repossessed on the 3rd, no condition report | none |
| Voluntary surrender | 4 |
